about_the_game:
Modavuj Games presents the game "Save The Babies".

The subject of the game Save The Babies

A malicious organization that carries out illegal activities wants to access a lot of secret information from the state. For this reason, it has kidnapped the daughters of important statesmen. The organization hides these kidnapped girls in a large industrial zone protected by artificial intelligence robot soldiers. The state has planned a top-secret operation called "Save The Babies" to save these girls.

For this operation, you, our hero, codenamed "Bodyguard", one of the state's best agents, have been chosen.

What's in the game

You will engage in armed conflicts with artificial intelligence robot soldiers. You will also use vehicles, motorcycles and bicycles to reach each of the 8 stages.

You will try to reach the kidnapped girls by jumping on the moving stone blocks without falling into the sea.

You will try to move quickly without getting caught by the rolling stone balls.

How to complete the game.

You will complete the game when you find the 8 kidnapped girls in 8 different stages.

We hope you enjoy the game. Have fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 650TI OR AMD R7 250x
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 970 OR NVidia GTX 1060 3GB OR AMD R9 290x OR AMD RX 470
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Save The Babies is an adventure game where you enter into armed conflicts with robots and try to overcome many platform obstacles. In 8 levels, you need to save 8 girls by overcoming obstacles that become more difficult as you progress.
